data.name: Blackwall [LIVE]
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

After an emergency call, you’re deployed to investigate a building where people have gone missing no communication, no confirmed survivors. Your bodycam is active, recording everything as you enter.

But something isn’t right. The silence feels unnatural. The environment shifts in ways you can’t explain. Hallways seem to change. Rooms don’t stay the same.

And something is moving in the corner.

You are not alone.

GAMEPLAY

This is a first-person psychological horror experience where survival depends on observation, decision making, and exploration.

·Explore a facility filled with hidden clues, locked areas, and disturbing discoveries

·Solve environmental puzzles to unlock doors, restore systems, and progress deeper.

·Manage limited weapons including pistols and shotguns use them carefully, not everything can be fought

·Investigate the mystery behind the missing people through documents, recordings, and environmental storytelling

·Experience immersive bodycam style visuals that place

FEATURES

·Bodycam perspective for realistic, immersive horror

·Puzzle-solving gameplay with locks, codes, and interactive systems

·Combat elements with limited ammo and tension-based encounters

·Story-driven exploration with secrets to uncover

·Atmospheric sound design that builds constant tension

·Unpredictable threats not everything behaves as expected

·Unique Monsters and Creatures

WHAT PLAYERS TO EXPECT

• A focused, story-driven psychological horror experience

• Shifting environments with exploration, puzzles, and survival combat

• Multiple creatures hunting you in a constantly changing maze

• A immersive world designed to keep you on edge at all times

• A bodycam perspective that intensifies realism and fear

data.short_description: A first-person psychological horror experience. One step changes everything, corridors shift, rooms distort, and monsters hunt you. Trapped in a living maze, you must fight to survive what should not exist and find an escape through your live bodycam.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains general mature content, including horror themes, depictions of corpses, and combat involving hostile creatures. Players use weapons such as guns to defend themselves. Violence is present but not depicted in an extreme or graphic manner.
